title: The Topology of $k$-Robust Clique Complexes in Grid-like Graphs
summary: We study $k$-robust clique complexes, a family of simplicial complexes that generalizes the traditional clique complex. Here, a subset of vertices forms a simplex provided it does not contain an independent set of size $k$. We investigate these complexes for square sequence graphs, a class of bipartite graphs introduced here that are constructed by iteratively attaching $C_4$ cycles. This class includes rectangular grid graphs $G_{m,n}$.
